# Alin Gherman (Hamsa) — Contemporary Composer

> Official website of Alin Gherman, contemporary composer: catalogue of compositions (percussion, solo, chamber, ensembles, opera, organ, brass, instrumental theatre, film/dance/media, electronic and computer music), invented percussion instruments, pressbook, photographs and links. Content is in English; one programme note is also available in Romanian.

## Compositions
- [Percussion Corner](https://alingherman.com/compositions-percussion.html): percussion works, including Purple Ritual (Geneva International Music Competition 2009)
- [Solo Instruments](https://alingherman.com/compositions-solo.html): works for percussion and piano
- [Piano Solo — Early Pieces](https://alingherman.com/compositions-solo-early.html)
- [Duos, Trios, Quartets & Quintets](https://alingherman.com/compositions-duos.html)
- [Early Duos, Trios, Quartets & Quintets](https://alingherman.com/compositions-duos-early.html)
- [Chamber / Symphonic Orchestra](https://alingherman.com/compositions-chamber.html)
- [Chamber Ensembles — Early Pieces](https://alingherman.com/compositions-chamber-early.html)
- [Medium & Large Ensembles](https://alingherman.com/compositions-orchestra.html)
- [Opera & Chamber Opera](https://alingherman.com/compositions-opera.html)
- [Organ](https://alingherman.com/compositions-organ.html)
- [Brass Music](https://alingherman.com/compositions-brass.html)
- [Instrumental Theatre](https://alingherman.com/compositions-theatre.html)
- [Music for Film, Theatre, Dance and Media](https://alingherman.com/compositions-film-dance-media.html)
- [Electronic Music](https://alingherman.com/compositions-electronic.html)
- [Computer Remixed Performances](https://alingherman.com/compositions-computer.html)
